notes.title: Rogue Night Update 0.6.9
notes.content: [h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The demo now allows for the saving of games, but keeps the one hour time limit. Starting a new game now restarts the demo timer.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Steam cloud saving.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new zone: Oarland Wood - a fall themed area with many twists and turns, and interconnected caves.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new dungeon: Deadroot Tunnel - a large cave system beneath Oarland Wood.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy: Giant Spiders - a large poisonous enemy that shoots webs and can trap the player in place.[/p][/*][*][p]Added rare chests - Blue and gold chests that offer better loot![/p][/*][*][p]Added Tomb Shroom - a deadly mushroom that explodes in a cloud of decay when hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new source of food: Mushrooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Anti-venom Mushroom - This will cure the player of poison if picked up while poisoned.[/p][/*][*][p]Added webs that slow the player, and webs that must be cut with a short sword or long sword to pass through.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy: Grubs - these small worms are slow and easy to dispatch.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new zone: The Bramble Path - A thorn covered zone that is home to a new type of enemy, and the entrance to a new dungeon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new enemy: Boars - these large boars charge the player quickly and become stunned when hitting a wall.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new dungeon: The Deep Brambles - this dungeon is the home of a new boss.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new boss: Eredorn - a fierce dwarf boss with a trick up his sleeve.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new fast travel waystone: Bramble Path.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new musical track for Oarland Wood and the Bramble Path.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the Elandris waystone into the city.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the depth on the tier 2 greatsword swing.[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial fox's light should no longer stick around if he vanishes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some alignment/depth issues with arrow traps in various dungeons.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor performance optimizations.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content: [h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The room name box will now expand to allow for longer room names.[/p][/*][*][p]Normal levers can now only be activated by using the multi-tool (left click.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new window on the character menu that shows key items.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new boss - Dimitri the fallen cleric![/p][/*][*][p]Added a new boss - Percy the undead thief![/p][/*][*][p]Added key items that drop from bosses - used to progress within the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a healing pickup that drops from crates, barrels, jars, and zombies![/p][/*][*][p]Removed the '?' box from the character select screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the sound of rain, making it much less annoying.[/p][/*][*][p]Made minor optimizations for framerate drops.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a large dungeon - Norwatch Keep.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Disabled weapon swapping with gamepad controls while opening/closing menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with depths of push blocks in dungeons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when killing skeletons wielding a spear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when saving near a trapped chest.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the display of some 2nd tier weapon names in the weapon inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Vines and ropes now function properly with 2nd tier weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing enter upon death in normal mode no longer takes the player to the upgrade screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected building placement for beehives, flower boxes, and herb gardens.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Debut Festival & 0.6.7 Update!
notes.content: [h2]Debut Festival![/h2][p]Rogue Night is currently being featured in the Debut Festival here on Steam! This festival features developers who have recently, or are expecting to release their first game as a studio. Additionally, the game received a late-night update last night. The changelog for this update is below:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]- Corrected weapons at merchant and weapon crafting bench.[/p][/*][*][p]- Crates and barrels no longer drop food.[/p][/*][*][p]- Added grappling utility to the whip, and added grappling locations throughout the world.[/p][/*][*][p]- Added "pull switches" that can be activated from a distance by using the scythe.[/p][/*][*][p]- Added vine covered switches and doors.[/p][/*][*][p]- Added hay stacks that can be ignited by a flaming crossbow bolt.[/p][/*][*][p]- Added tier 2/legendary weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]- Changed the attack speed stat to adjust the image speed of attacks rather than being tied to enemy iframes. The draw speed of ranged weapons do not change, but the speed of the projectile increases.[/p][/*][*][p]- Duplicate weapons now give 5 iron when picked up. This has always been the case, but this is now shown in a more intuitive way.[/p][/*][*][p]- Weapons must now be fully laying on the ground and motionless to be picked up.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]- Corrected depth issues with the cracked blocks that can be smashed with a hammer.[/p][/*][*][p]- Corrected gamepad/controller controls to work with new weapon system.[/p][/*][*][p]- Fixed an annoying bug that would play the 'deny' sound on loop when using the controller in the overworld.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Rogue Night Demo Update - 1.7
notes.content:
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a time limit to the demo, and disabled saving for the demo.
[*] Completely overhauled the weapon system and combat animations for the player.
[*] Removed many redundant weapons, dropping the total to 10. (10 more coming later!)
[*] Added two new weapon types: Whip and Scythe.
[*] Added a weapon bar at the bottom of the screen to display owned and equipped weapons.
[*] Weapons can now be equipped by using the scroll wheel or number keys.
[*] Updated the weapon inventory screen to display one weapon per page, and display more info on each weapon.
[*] Weapons now level up with use and gain increased damage, extra combo moves, and stat bonuses. Stat bonuses remain active even if the weapon is not equipped - gotta' level 'em all!
[*] Weapons also have their own unique utility, which is used by swinging the weapon at an object. These are listed below.
[list]

[*] Daggers can now be used to pick locked chests.
[*] Short swords and longswords can be used to cut rope. To utilize this, a crane object has been added, more to come later.
[*] Spears can be used to hit hard to reach wall switches.
[*] Bows can be used to shoot down hanging objects. Added goblin balloons which hold chests.
[*] Crossbows, when leveled can fire flaming bolts. These can be used to ignite explosive barrels. Added explosive barrels.
[*] Greatswords can be used to slice through chains. Added a chain that holds a mystery object above the players head. Cut it down and see what you get!
[*] Warhammers can be used to smash large cracked blocks, potentially revealing something below. Added these blocks.
[/list]
[*] Added four new quests for survivors requiring items.
[*] Added pushable blocks for puzzles, some can be pushed farther than others, some require switches to deactivate.
[*] Blue dungeon walls now appear lighter if they are outside.
[*] Chests now play a 'deny' sound if the player is holding no keys.
[*] Foundation tiles have been placed below walls in town.
[*] Slightly updated the chest sprite.
[*] Added goblin chests that do not require keys.
[*] Added spike traps that deploy when the player is near.
[*] Added spike traps that are coated in poison.
[*] Added fire traps that look like spike traps at first glance.
[*] Added wind current traps that push the player.
[*] Added sand pits that slow player movement.
[*] Made slight adjustments to rolling, and the player is now invulnerable to damage while rolling - this does not apply to environmental damage, however.
[*] Added two new times of floor switches - one that must only be stepped on once, and another that requires constant pressure to stay active.
[*] Added timed gates.
[*] Added arrow traps.
[*] Added spike traps that turn into fire traps when the spikes are lowered.
[*] Added a spinning blade trap.
[*] Added a new enemy type - Animated Armor. There are two styles of this enemy.
[*] Players can no longer build structures in the glade near the lumberjack's hut.
[*] Removed the druid survivor from the demo.
[*] Made bats much less annoying.
[*] Added an additional portal to the Witch Between Worlds near Xerithil. (This is not accessible in the demo.)
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slimes now pause.
[*] Fixed an issue with a persistent item that caused an infinite loading screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused enemies to freeze if the player touched a wall.
[*] Fixed a bug that would allow the player to go to the upgrade screen if they pushed escape while dying on normal mode.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused poison damage to tick despite the game being paused.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Fox NPC would move, but his light would not.
[*] Fixed a bug where survivors could not be summoned if a player died before summoning them.
[*] Corrected a few misplaced tiles.

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.6.4 Update
notes.content:
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an intro video when starting a new game.
[*] Added a link to the [url=greynovembergames.com]Grey November Games Website[/url] at the title screen.
[*] Updated the tutorial system, to now draw mouse and keyboard controls on the screen.
[*] Added a fox NPC that guides the character through the tutorial quests.

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.6.3 Update
notes.content:
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new enemy - the Wight. This undead wields longswords and has the ability to summon zombies!
[*] Added a new enemy - Slimes. Slimes inflict the poisoned condition and when destroyed, split into two smaller slimes. These do no damage and do not inflict poison.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

[*] Fixed a bug that caused pickup items to crash the game randomly.

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.6.2 Update!
notes.content:
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the town of Xerithil, which lies to the east of Elandris.
[*] Added the Xerithil Crypt, a new dungeon.
[*] Added jars that are quite satisfying to break.
[*] Grass growth has returned! Cut it all!
[*] Added indestructible buildings, such as sheds, a crypt, and windmills.
[*] Pick up items should no longer pop through walls, but should now go immediately to the player if they get stuck.
[*] Added road signs.
[*] Relocated the priest survivor.
[*] Added the engineer as a survivor NPC.
[*] The Underhall now may only be accessed from the south entrance.
[*] The build menu can now be opened to a specific page by pressing 1,2,3 or 4.
[*] Only 9 keys may be held at any given time.
[*] Default music volume has been raised slightly.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stepping stones now cost 2 stone to create, rather than 10 iron.
[*] Put a storage cap on crystals.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused regeneration particles to go haywire on loading a new game.
[*] Pick up items no longer teleport to the player if the player is not near the item.

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.6.0 Update!
notes.content:
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Waystones - a method of quickly traveling around the world.
[*] Added a new NPC - the engineer! This NPC can be summoned by building the Drafting Table, and allows for the construction of many new structures.
[*] Added Arrow Tower - a tower that fires arrows at enemies within range.
[*] Added Power Source - a structure that powers engineer buildings. 
[*] Added Gearforge - a structure that increases the build time of all structures, requires power.
[*] Added Electromagnet - a structure that collects all dropped resources in a large area, requires power.
[*] Added Cannon Tower - a tower that fires cannon balls at enemies within range.
[*] Added Lantern - a source of light that is larger than the campfire or brazier.
[*] Added Reinforced Walls - The strongest type of wall, built of stone and iron.
[*] Added Reinforced Door - A medium-tier door, made of wood and iron.
[*] Added Trap Doors - A set of doors that allow the player to travel quickly between them.
[*] Added Compost Container - Increases the speed of wheat growth on Farmland.
[*] Added a new NPC - the priest! This NPC can be summoned by building the Altar, and unlocks holy structures.
[*] Added Divine Crystal - A large structure that powers priest buildings.
[*] Added Symbol of Protection - A structure that applies a permanent buff as long as the structure exists and is powered. This buff decreases all incoming damage from undead.
[*] Added Symbol of Strength - A structure that applies a permanent buff as long as the structure exists and is powered. This buff increases all damage done to undead.
[*] Added Herb Garden - This is used by the priest to upgrade potions to the highest tier. Upgrading requires a priest, this structure, a merchant, and a level 2 potion.
[*] Added Resurrection Statue - A structure that breaks upon death, but grants an additional life to the player. The player is spawned where the statue once stood.
[*] Added Wall Hanging - A selection of decorative wall hangings.
[*] Added Fireplace - An interior source of light with the same radius as a lantern.
[*] Added Iron Door - The strongest, and highest tier door available. 
[*] Added a new NPC - the wizard! This NPC can be summoned by building the Ritual Altar, and unlocks magic structures.
[*] Added the Rune Trap - a deadly rune that explodes and immediately kills all undead on contact, and destroys rune upon triggering.
[*] Added Waystone - a personal fast travel beacon.
[*] Added Philosophers Stone - generates all resources daily at the cost of gold. Requires power.
[*] Added Slow Rune - slows all enemies in an area permanently, but destroys rune upon triggering. 
[*] Added Obelisk - powers wizard buildings.
[*] Added Arcane Forge - Unlocks the ability to craft the Arcane Sword at the Weapon Bench. Requires Power.
[*] Dying inside a dungeon while playing in 'easy mode' now returns you to your campfire rather than the start location.
[*] Multi-tool level 3 is now attainable from the weapon crafting as long as the player has reached multi-tool level 2.
[*] The druid NPC does not require food as she can produce her own. Otherwise, all NPCs now consume food at midnight, providing there's enough to go around.
[*] Updated the "gain" sound effect.
[*] Added a second page of conditions to the help screen. This shows positive conditions on the first, and negative on the second. Added Symbol of Protection and Symbol of Strength.
[*] Zombies should now spawn further away from base structures.
[*] The Trap can no longer be built too near other traps.
[*] Chests now have a 400% greater chance to drop blueprints, and 200% greater chance to drop rings. Additionally, they will only not drop a special item if they randomly drop a blueprint that is already unlocked. They also now have a chance to drop one crystal.
[*] Added new builds to the shop, and chests.


[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked the way buildings are locked/unlocked, and fixed a few inconsistencies. 
[*] Structures can no longer be built on top of NPCs, and NPCs can no longer walk through various structures.
[*] Fixed a bug where the multi-tool pickup would follow the player, rather than being picked up.
[*] Structures no longer make a sound when loaded.
[*] Structures no longer spawn particles when loaded.
[*] Slightly adjusted the right bounds of the textbox so that text being displayed does not begin to overlap the borders of the textbox.
[*] Fixed an issue where structures could be built on top of the player.
[*] Fixed an issue where players with different resolutions and aspect ratios had issues with mouse alignment. The current fix is as follows : 
   - If a player's resolution is 1920x1080 then the game starts in full screen and the software (art) cursor is shown. 
   - If a players resolution is greater or less than 1920x1080 but the aspect ratio is the same, the game is shown in full screen but the cursor is drawn as the hardware cursor. 
   - If a player's aspect ratio is not 16:9, then the game is put into borderless window mode, and the cursor is drawn as the hardware cursor.

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.5.7 Update!
notes.content:
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new NPC - the druid! Find and rescue her to unlock 5 new structures, all listed below. When the druid is under attack by undead, she will summon vines to root them in place!
[*] Added the Grovestone - This structure summons the druid when built.
[*] Added Druidic Walls - These are inexpensive walls of thorn that are easily destroyed, but also do damage to the attacker.
[*] Added Healing Fountain - A large flower that produces healing water. Using the structure will restore the player to full health.
[*] Added Fishing Pond - Now you can fish from the comfort of your base!
[*] Added Apple Tree - These trees take time to grow, but produce additional food for you and your survivors.
[*] Added Weapon Bench - This allows for the crafting of most weapons, along with an upgrade for the multi-tool
[*] Added Market Stall - This stall summons a merchant NPC that sells weapons, blueprints, a potion upgrade, and magic rings!
[*] Added Stone Brick Oven - This oven doubles the amount of food gained from wheat that has been harvested in the overworld.
[*] Added a new pick up item - crystals! These resources now have their own place on the resource bar and are used for building higher tier structures.
[*] Rocks now have a 5% chance of spawning as crystal rocks. This only applies to rocks in caves.
[*] The Magi's band now functions properly with the addition of crystals.
[*] Changed all NPCs to vanish at the same rate when rescued.
[*] Updated the pick up art for the great club.
[*] The potion power upgrade now adds the bonus of the upgrade, rather than multiplying it. This is so that higher level potions are relevant.
[*] Added potion level 2.
[*] The piercing shot on the crossbow has been limited to 2-3 enemies, down from infinite.
[*] Increased the drop rate of blueprints in chests.
[*] Aiming with the bow or crossbow while alternate control mode is active, now updates in real time, allowing you to hold a shot and aim with your mouse.
[*] Farmland price has increased from 40 gold to 50.
[*] Removed the miner "boss" from Mine L-3 and replaced with goblins.
[*] The Multi-tool level 2 can be picked up from dead miners, which now spawn in place of zombies in the Old Mine in the Greatwood.
[*] Birds on the ground now fly away when loading a save that contains a structure built where the bird was sitting.
[*] Changed the way bats behave slightly.


[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rings that drop extra resources now only drop extra when that specific resource is harvested.
[*] Interior resources are no longer destroyed upon leaving and re-entering interior rooms.
[*] Fixed an issue in the Undercroft where the character would leave the center of the screen, making the alternate control style act up a bit.
[*] Fixed a couple of small collision issues with the end of mine cart tracks in the Old Mine.
[*] Picking up a blueprint no longer unlocks the building if the required structure is not made.
[*] Skills that are active during death in easy mode now stop and the cooldown is reset upon spawning.
[*] Doors can no longer be destroyed by holding ctrl and hitting with a weapon.
[*] Goblins should get stuck less.
[/list]

Thanks for playing, and tell your friends about Rogue Night!

notes.title: Rogue Night Demo Update 1.61
notes.content:
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a pretty nasty bug that would cause players to teleport all over inside the old mine after leaving through the south exit and re-entering the mine.
[*] Smoothed out alternate control scheme, and bound the mouse to a circle rather than a rectangle.
[*] Added to tiles to connect the mine cart tracks between the old mine main tunnels and southern tunnels.
[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Night Demo Update 1.6
notes.content:
[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new feature - magic rings! These are found in chests and all sorts of magical bonuses such as extra damage, crit chance, passive healing, and an extra life!
[*] Equipped rings and multi-tool are now shown on the character screen. Press 'C' while in game to open, and click the ring slot to swap rings.
[*] Weapons, keys, rings, blueprints, and quest items now show an icon above the player's head when picked up.
[*] Updated the blueprint sprite.
[*] Blueprints no longer decay over time.
[*] Woodworking table blueprint now has a chance to drop from chests.
[*] Chests no longer have a 100% chance to drop gems.
[*] Chests now have a chance to drop rings.
[*] Barrels and crates now have a chance to drop a dagger or a club.
[*] Goblins now trigger combat music.
[*] Destroying objects on top of floors no longer destroys the floor as well.
[*] Updated the button for the wooden floor within the build menu.
[*] Structures can now be built at a distance of 32 pixels from the player, up from 24.
[*] Cut down the total amount of insects that can spawn at once.
[*] Changed the way that insects fly.
[*] All structures - unlocked or locked are now drawn on the build menu in all 3 pages.
[*] Buildings that spawn NPCs are now saved instantly, preventing players from being locked out of NPCs if saving while the structure is being built.
[*] Any found blueprints are now saved. This prevents any inconsistencies among building unlocks.
[*] The forge and woodworking table can no longer be built over top of the player, locking them in place.
[*] Alternative Movement is now the default method of movement. This can still be switched within the options menu.
[*] Added multiple structures that can be built within the demo. These must all be unlocked by building a workbench, and finding their respective blueprint.
[*] Added bed - A structure that allows the player to sleep so that time may pass more quickly. The world continues on as normal, however. If an enemy gets near the bed while the player is sleeping, the player will wake up.
[*] Added flower planter - A planter full of flowers with different styles. Used as decoration and speeds up the production time of honey.
[*] Added fishing net - A passive style of fishing, and a new source of food. This can only be built on fishing holes.
[*] Added target dummy - Any undead that are nearby will attack the dummy rather than the player. These can be destroyed but can last longer by downgrading the structure damage of zombies.
[*] Added beehives - These produce honey over time, and additional source of food.
[*] Added bees that fly from the beehives.
[*] Added traps - Hunting traps that trap zombies in place, these can be built away from a light source, but only in the overworld.
[*] Added rugs - 3 different colors of rugs, that must be placed on floors. Useful for decoration.
[*] Added stepping stones - stones that can serve as a small walkway, used as an outdoor decoration.

[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Players and enemies can no longer walk over the altar in the Church of Thurm in Elandris.
[*] Fixed a bug where the crops grown on farmland were set at a depth below the farmland itself.
[*] Removed the random bridge in the mine level 3.
[*] Fixed an issue with collisions in mine level 2.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause players to spawn in the wrong location when entering an interior space after leaving the mine.
[*] Players can no longer attack after death in easy mode.
[*] Rolling while dead no longer causes the death animation to stutter.
[*] Destroying the forge structure no longer crashes the game.
[*] All crops are now saved individually, and are no longer lost on loading if older than 3 days.
[*] Attacking north no longer has an increased range over other directions. This will continue to be dialed in.
[/list]

notes.title: New Steam Capsule Art
notes.content:
You may have noticed the new page art for the game. It was done by [url=https://x.com/cleitonvsart]Cleiton Venancio on twitter[/url]. A huge 'thank you' goes out to him for all of his hard work!

In other news, there's an update in the works, which will add more buildable structures to the demo-as well as rings that give different bonuses when equipped. There have also been improvements to weapon and other pick-up items. Stay tuned for more on this.

[*] Zombies can no longer walk through the purple carriage or market stalls in northern Elandris.
[*] Resources no longer drop endlessly when a player is killed in normal mode.
[*] Updated the death theme music by Nicole Marie T.

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.5.61a Update
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]

[*] Added a new dungeon to the game.
[*] Added a complete new soundtrack to the game, composed by Nicole Marie T. (The title theme has stayed.)
[*] Updated the credits screen to reflect the new soundtrack.
[*] Adjusted the way that music is played in game, based on time of day and location.
[*] Dungeon music will no longer restart if it is already playing.
[*] Crates and barrels now drop 5 wood, down from 10.
[*] Crates and barrels now have a chance to drop food.
[*] Crates and barrels now have a chance to drop gold.
[*] Crates and barrels no longer drop weapons.
[*] Bats are no longer stuck in mines/dungeons.
[*] Bats can now be hit with arrows and bolts.
[*] Critical hits against bats now do damage.
[*] Bats now do more damage and flee in a chosen direction rather than bouncing away when hit.
[*] Bats no longer spawn based on time in dungeons, but have a set amount per room.
[*] Fixed a few minor pixel drawing errors.
[*] Ruin walls are now saved and destroyed properly upon load, preventing performance issues.
[*] Dressers now load with the proper scaling upon the x-axis (they wont be backwards anymore.)
[*] Ruined walls now update properly.
[*] Limited the amount of resources lost at death in easy mode.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause massive framerate drops after entering a room with bridges.
[*] Corrected collision on the anvil.
[*] Breaking a brazier now destroys the light it provided.
[*] Adjusted depth on many things, such as blood spots, farmland, and skeleton bones.
[*] Adjusted the way that insects work, and turned up the amount of them.
[*] NPCs should no longer walk through ruined walls.
[*] Players or NPCs should be able to walk through doors if the door is closed on them.
[*] NPC dialogue should be unavailable if close to a door.
[*] Blood stains and skeleton bones can no longer block doors from being closed.
[*] Skeleton hands no longer lag behind while the skeleton moves.
[*] Fixed a bug where disabled zombies remain disabled after entering the portal on easy mode.
[*] Fixed the annoying zombie and enemy flickering between directions.
[*] Music/SFX levels now remain consistent through different rooms when adjusted in the options menu.
[*] Updated collision masks in all room. This is most noticeable around doors and ledges.
[*] F3 no longer changes the weather, but still takes screenshots.
[*] F2 no longer shows debugging info.

[/list]
Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.5.5a Update
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]

[*] Fixed the pixel art cursor, and added an option to enable hardware cursor if the pixel art cursor gets buggy. This can be done by pressing F1 at any time.
[*] Fixed a bug that disabled structure placement with a controller.
[*] Updated the portal sprite in easy mode.
[*] Zombies are now 'disabled' while far from the player. This prevents zombies from destroying most structures before the player has reached them.
[*] Changed the way speed is applied while rolling, resulting in a faster roll. This also makes it possible to roll at a faster speed while sprinting as the ranger class.
[*] Current health is now saved and reloaded when using 'save and quit' and restarting the game.
[*] Added loading/saving screen art and lore text.
[*] Added a death screen upon player defeat in easy mode.
[*] Added a fountain in Elandris.
[*] Added stone signs.
[*] Added bookshelves that tell lore.
[*] Campfire regen no longer continues upon death.
[*] If the player dies while hungry in easy mode, they will no longer respawn with the hungry condition.
[*] Bats now fly away at dawn, and should stay away.
[*] Added timed spike traps.
[*] Added switches.
[*] Added switches that control spike traps.
[*] Added iron gates.
[*] Added switches that raise and lower iron gates.
[*] Added bridges.
[*] Added switches that extend and retract bridges.
[*] Bats now drop gold.
[*] Ghosts drop gold again.
[*] Added goblins!
[*] Placed goblins and dungeon items throughout the world.
[*] Made many changes to underground 'dungeons' throughout the world.
[*] Made big changes to the alternate controls option. The controls are now more intuitive and the cursor now shows as a crosshair and is bound to an area around the player.
[*] The amount of keys held are always shown on the screen, even if the amount is 0.
[*] Changed the crosshair sprite, making it smaller.


[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.5.4a Update
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]

[*] Added 'easy mode' - where permanent death is removed, and only held resources are lost upon death. Players will respawn at their base if they have a campfire, otherwise they respawn at the starting area.
[*] Added a portal to the Witch Between Worlds - where players can purchase permanent upgrades while playing in Easy Mode. The portal sprite is a place holder and will change in the future.
[*] Added a new type of enemy - bats! They can fly over walls and spawn at night. They don't do much damage, but add an extra challenge when facing zombies.
[*] Added notifications on the weapon inventory screen for when a new weapon has been picked up.
[*] Added a new type of bird, and brought back the old crows in trees.
[*] brought back bugs and small flying critters.
[*] Zone names should update properly now, and the map now shows player location.
[*] Equipped items, portion, and ability icons no longer vanish when menus are opened on their respective sides.
[*] Adjusted zombie threat distance.
[*] Fixed the attack animation for the upward great axe attack.
[*] Fixed an error where the 'return' button would appear greyed out in the options menus.
[*] The pixel art cursor is back!
[*] Fixed the terrible stuttering rain sound.
[*] Changed the pitch and volume of the healing chime sound. It should be much more pleasant now.
[*] Added invulnerability while lunging during attack combos.
[*] Replaced some enemies with bats in cave locations.
[*] Ghosts should no longer spam the player with attacks after breaking out of a rock.
[*] Fixed an issue with the origin point of the lumberjack and his attack animations.
[*] Corrected the strange collision issue with the lumberjack's axe structure.
[*] Screen shake should now work properly in caves and interior locations.
[*] The new game window has been fixed and is no longer displayed off of screen.


[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Night is in Steam's Open World Survival Crafting fest!
Rogue Night 0.5.3a Update
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]

[*] Added attack combos! Each weapon has it's own unique combo. Combos may be used by pressing the attack button a second time while the first attack is still in motion. Some combos have lunge abilities if the player is moving, some have guaranteed critical hits, while others have special ranged abilities.
[*] The 'Cozy Campfire' upgrade stats should now be displayed properly on the meta-upgrade screen.
[*] The infinite loading screen bug when getting hit backwards through a door should be resolved.
[*] Adjusted knockback - hitting an enemy no longer knocks the player back, and player hits against enemies have stronger knockback.
[*] Screen shake has been reduced when hitting an enemy, screen shake has been increased when being hit by an enemy.
[*] The light radius of a campfire is now destroyed when the campfire is destroyed.
[*] The following buttons may be used to exit from the death screen to the meta-upgrade screen: Esc, enter, or mouse click.
[*] The knockback meta-upgrade has been moved to tier 3 upgrades, but has had all prerequisites removed.
[*] Chests require keys again.
[*] Doors should be working properly again.
[*] Zombies now shamble around each other - rather than stacking up on each other.
[*] Fixed inconsistent tutorial quests. 
[*] Limited the amount of zombies/skeletons that can spawn in interior areas, and increased the amount of zombies that can spawn in the overworld. This will likely be adjusted in the future.
[*] The 'E' no longer displays over the great club art while the great club is equipped.
[*] Increased the chance of hitting zombies with an arrow or bolt.
[*] Zombies and skeletons now reset their positions when leaving and reentering an interior area. This is to prevent a large amount of enemies piling up at the entrance to the area.
[*] The meta-upgrade page can be exited while in gamepad mode by pressing 'Start' or 'B/Circle".
[*] The left thumbstick can now be used to control the cursor on the character select screen.
[*] The 'Scavenger' meta-upgrade may now be properly unlocked in tier 2, and no longer has secret tier 3 requirements.
[*] The mouse will now bind to the window while building structures.
[*] Removed smaller window sizes, the game now supports fullscreen, borderless window, and windowed mode at 1080p.
[*] Fixed a bug where saving and quitting and reloading would increase storage capacity for each crate/barrel built.
[*] Fixed a bug where breaking the forge would cause a crash.
[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes passing between levels of the player-built mine would cause a crash.
[*] Changed the sound of rain.

[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.4.9a Update
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Steam achievements have been added. (They've been available for a while but some were buggy and should be functioning properly now.)
[*] Added a dodge roll mechanic.
[*] Changed controls of special abilities to accommodate for dodge roll controls. Space bar now dodges, and the 'F' key now activates special abilities. Also changed the help menu to reflect the changes in controls.
[*] The option for borderless window mode is no longer opposite.
[*] Added full controller support.
[*] Added a new option to the options window: Enable gamepad - Enable/Disable the use of controllers.
[*] Added a new option to the options window: Gamepad style - Change the controller button display from Xbox style to PS.
[*] Added a new option to the options window: Gamepad Speed - Adjust the speed of the controller cursor.
[*] Any mouse click, keyboard press, or gamepad button press will now send the player to the Meta-Upgrades menu after death.
[*] Zombies and skeletons should now get stuck much less frequently.
[*] Added hotkey notation for the lantern, strafing, rolling, and destroying objects. This is shown in both mouse and keyboard modes as well as controller mode. This option can be disabled in the options menu.
[*] Fixed a typo on a 'How to play' page at the title screen.
[*] If windowed mode is enabled, the game will now start in windowed mode.
[*] Fixed a bug where the mouse would be locked outside the game window when the game is set to windowed mode at smaller resolutions.
[*] Updated the help menu controls section to reflect gamepad controls when controller mode is enabled.
[*] Unlockable doors are now saved, and are no longer required to be unlocked a second time after exiting the game.
[*] Chests are now saved, and do not respawn after saving and exiting.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would crash after leaving the player-built mine.
[*] Fixed the broken discord link at the title screen.
[*] Skeletons no longer walk through doors. They now open them!
[*] Added an effect for zombie spawning.
[*] Removed the white ring from the war hammer attack animation.
[*] *Hopefully* fixed the pesky loading screen bug.
[*] Volume adjusters should now work properly.
[*] Music should no longer overlap in caves.

[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.4.8a Update
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Doors, cliffs, cavern walls, and trees can no longer be shot through with the bow or crossbow.
[*] Fixed incorrect positioning of collision on the rails of the old mine.
[*] Leaving the player-built mine no longer can trigger dialogue with the miner, causing a loop where the player cannot leave the mine.
[*] Loading the game should no longer reset food growth.
[*] The 'how to play' section now correctly states time for food growth (now 3 days from 7).
[*] Fixed an inconsistency with partially completing tutorial quests and then choosing to skip the tutorial after saving and exiting the game.
[*] Skeletons should no longer get stuck.
[*] Ghosts no longer drop loot.
[*] Zombies breaking crates can no longer be heard across the entire map.
[*] Arrow and bolt sounds no longer play if they are slightly off screen.
[*] Torch no longer turns off when entering the northern part of the old mine.
[*] Ghosts now display in alternate colors.
[*] The music, sfx, and ambient volume controls now work properly.
[*] Fixed the journal button that used to open and close immediately.
[*] The weapon inventory now closes if the game menu is opened over top of it.
[*] Added a world map.
[*] Corrected structure destruction targeting. (It's now much easier to accurately destroy walls, etc.)
[*] Stumps and other resources now load at the correct depth.
[*] Increased and balanced the reach on the rusty sword and short sword attack animations.
[*] Zombies now attack relentlessly from the hours of 1am-6am.
[*] The help menu now tells how to destroy items in the 'controls' section.
[*] Zombies can correctly break doors now.
[*] Updated the help menu 'controls' section and the on screen hotkeys to display the correct controls if the 'Alternate Movement' option is selected.
[*] The area name should be correctly displayed on the clock if the option is set to do so.

[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.4.7a Update
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added many new options to the option menu.
[*] The option menu is now accessible from the title screen.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies with starting a new game, and death.
[*] Added an option for windowed mode.
[*] Added an option for borderless window.
[*] Options are now saved as a separate file, and loaded at the launch of the game.
[*] Turned down the volume of the regeneration sound effect.
[*] Slightly adjusted regeneration effect particles.
[*] Regeneration particles and sound effects only play when below max health.
[*] Fixed an issue where players would get an infinite loading screen while entering the old mine.
[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.4.5a Update
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented quests within the game, to give new players direction.
[*] Tutorial quests may be skipped. (Quest rewards are still granted at the start of a new run/game.)
[*] Bushes are now saved in the same manner as other resources, reducing save/load times.
[*] Berries may now be collected from bushes at diagonal angles.
[*] Zombies and skeletons have had their pathing/AI reworked, and will target doors before walls.
[*] Skeletons can now open doors.
[*] Footstep sound effects now stop when the player is sprinting but not moving, and play at double speed while sprinting.
[*] Updated hotkey icons at the bottom of the screen, and added two icons - The quest journal, and a map (coming soon.)
[*] Zombies that attack a door, but miss now play a scratching sound.
[*] Objects breaking in the distance can no longer be heard when far away.
[*] Collision boxes in the blacksmith's cellar are no longer visible.
[*] Slightly updated the appearance of the roadmap button on the main menu to match the other buttons.
[*] Added an effect that triggers while regenerating near a campfire.
[*] Health regeneration is no longer prevented while having the 'Starving' condition.
[*] Zombies no longer spawn while the game is paused.
[*] Zombies only spawn while within a certain range of the player, but spawn more frequently.
[*] Zombies now wander in 8 directions, up from 4.
[*] Fixed an issue where two upgrades were placed in the wrong tier on the Meta-Upgrade screen.
[*] The current day is now reset upon death.




[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.4.4a update
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Berries that have been gathered can no longer be gathered again by saving and reloading.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cursor was invisible on the character select screen.
[*] Fixed a rare issue with an infinite load screen in the Old Mine.
[*] The dead miner's attack animation is now destroyed when killed.
[*] If a ghost drops a coin onto an unreachable area, the coin is immediately collected.
[*] Added water sounds near water sources
[*] Sound effects for walls being damaged in the distance should scale a bit better.
[*] Menu close sounds no longer overlap.
[*] All menus now close when selecting a buildable item.
[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.4.2 alpha update
notes.content:
[h2][b][u]Rogue Night 0.4.2a update[/u][/b][/h2]
[hr][/hr]
This update fixes an eternal load screen issue, and minor bugs

[*] Pickup items will no longer despawn while the game is paused

notes.title: Rogue Night 0.4.1 alpha update!
notes.content:
[h2][b][u]Rogue Night 0.4.1a update[/u][/b][/h2]
[hr][/hr]
This update addresses a few graphical errors and other little bugs, as well as small changes to combat and character abilities.

[h3][u]New Features:[/u][/h3]
[code]
[list]
[*] Updated sprite for placing stone floors
[*] Increased skeleton movement speed
[*] Added a new tile for room transitions in long hallways
[*] Increased the amount of zombies in Elandris
[*] Added a very slight knockback to the player after hitting an enemy with weapon
[*] Increased the duration of each character's special ability by 4x
[*] Polished main menu buttons and new game confirmation
[*] Gold coins should pop out of chests in a more satisfying way
[*] Reduced saving time by a huge amount
[*] The game should now autosave when leaving the main buildable area
[*] Crops now take 3 days to grow, and must be hit with a weapon or tool to be harvested.
[/list]
[/code]
[hr][/hr]

[code]
[list]

[*] Weapons now break crates and barrels in a more satisfying way
[*] Miner no longer flashes in his location for a moment after he has been rescued
[*] Mining pick is now destroyed if the Miner is unlocked
[*] Fixed an issue where the storage limit would grow on exiting and continuing
[*] Fixed overlap on some tiles
[*] Fixed an issue where the dead miner would cause the game to crash
[*] Building a stone floor should no longer place random floor tiles
[*] Fixed a bug where building stone structures would require a restart of the game to work after unlocking the Mason
[*] Fixed an issue where players could build a mine or farmland on a bridge.
[*] Players may no longer build multiple woodworking tables
[*] The dead miner is no longer invisible
[*] Fixed an issue where lights would move around in caves
[*] Fixed an issue where lights were off center
[*] Fixed an issue where pickup items would get stuck in walls
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing 'E' multiple times near a ladder would cause the player to bounce back and forth between areas even while loading
